How to get these: register free at stead: How to get these: register free at steadfast.com.bd/register, then in the merchant panel open API → Your API keys and copy the Api-Key and Secret-Key. There is no fee for API access.
How to get these: register free at merch: How to get these: register free at merchant.pathao.com/register, add your store and payment info, then open the Developer API section in the panel for the Client ID and Secret. The username is your merchant login email. A new store takes about an hour to be approved.
How to get this: register at redx.com.bd: How to get this: register at redx.com.bd, then in the merchant panel open Settings → developer section and generate the access token. If that section is missing, ask RedX support to enable Open API access. There is no fee for API access.
How to get these: register free at merch: How to get these: register free at merchant.carrybee.com/register, then ask your Carrybee account manager (KAM) or support for the API credentials — they issue the Client ID, Secret and Context. There is no fee for API access. Sandbox access also comes from Carrybee technical support (ecomsupport@carrybee.com) — tick Sandbox Mode only with sandbox credentials they give you.
How to get these: register at ecourier.c: How to get these: register at ecourier.com.bd and wait for eCourier to activate your account, then copy the API-KEY, API-SECRET and USER-ID from the panel's API credentials section — or ask eCourier support. The fraud check needs eCourier support to switch it on.
